core_obligations: Record that b is a local complete intersection morphism and that E is the projective space bundle of the finite locally free conormal sheaf, hence smooth over Z (proof lines 13827-13840).
Apply the base change comparison of Gysin maps to get res(b^!) = c_top(C^vee) o pi^! and replace pi^! by pi^* using the local complete intersection case (proof lines 13842-13848).
Identify the kernel C with the kernel F of pi^* C_{Z/X} -> C_{E/X'} using the vanishing of H^{-1}(NL_{E/Z}) and the exact sequences for E -> X' -> X and E -> Z -> X (proof lines 13850-13865).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the smooth projective bundle situation (proof lines 13827-13840).
The base change comparison and the replacement of pi^! by pi^* (proof lines 13842-13848).
Identification of the two kernels and conclusion (proof lines 13850-13865).
difficulty_reason: For a regular closed immersion i : Z -> X of schemes locally of finite type over a base (S, delta) and b : X' -> X the blowing up in Z with exceptional divisor E, the lemma asserts that, assuming the Gysin map for b exists, res(b^!) = c_top(F^vee) o pi^* in A^*(E -> Z), where F is the kernel of the canonical map pi^* C_{Z/X} -> C_{E/X'} (statement lines 13807-13825). The proof notes that b is a local complete intersection morphism by More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-blowup-regular-sequence, so the statement makes sense, and that regularity of Z -> X makes C_{Z/X} finite locally free with Sym^*(C_{Z/X}) isomorphic to the conormal algebra by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-quasi-regular-immersion, whence E = Proj(C_{Z/X,*}) = P(C_{Z/X}) is a projective space bundle over Z, in particular smooth and a local complete intersection morphism (proof lines 13827-13840). Lemma labelled lemma-compare-gysin-base-change then gives res(b^!) = c_top(C^vee) o pi^! for the kernel C occurring there, and Lemma labelled lemma-lci-gysin-flat lets pi^! be replaced by pi^* (proof lines 13842-13848). What remains is the identification of the two kernels: since E -> Z is smooth, H^{-1}(NL_{E/Z}) vanishes by More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-NL-smooth, and the exact sequences of More on Morphisms, Lemmas labelled more-morphisms-lemma-get-triangle-NL and more-morphisms-lemma-NL-immersion, both for E -> X' -> X and for E -> Z -> X, identify F with H^{-1}(j^* NL_{X'/X}) and hence with C (proof lines 13850-13865). Identifying the abstract kernel from the base change comparison with the concrete kernel of the conormal map, using the two exact sequences of the normal cone, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
